member.name: T:Kjs.AppLife.Update.Controller.UpdateController
member.summary: The forms the core of the AppLife Update system in the application that will be updated. It enables the application to communicate with an update server and download, validate, and apply updates.

remarks.para: To use an , you must first initialize it with information about the update server and the application being updated. The and properties link the controller to an update server, and the property allows it to validate updates. These three properties must be set before the controller can be used to download and apply updates.

In order to determine what updates are available, the controller needs to know the application's version. This information is stored in the property. If the property is , will automatically be set to the version of the current application.
If the controller may be working through a proxy to download updates, you can use the , , , , , , and properties to configure proxy settings.

The controller can also be used to perform each step of the update process separately. To only contact the update server and find what update (if any) is available, use the , , or methods. Each of these methods fills in the and properties with information from the update server. To download the update represented by , use the , , or methods. Once an update has been successfully downloaded, the IsDownloaded property of will be set to . To validate a downloaded update, use the method. To apply a downloaded update, use the method. Like , can shut down the application.

When checking for an update, the will analyze the updates it finds on the update server and choose the highest update that can be applied to . You can handle the event to further filter updates based on custom criteria.

member.summary: Uses built-in dialogs to walk the user through an entire update process.

remarks.para:
This method combines the functionality of
and and adds a step to automatically attempt to apply the update and display any error that occurs when doing so to the user.

This method displays a "Check for updates" dialog. If an update is found and the user chooses to get it, this method will automatically download it and display a progress dialog. If the download succeeds and is not cancelled by the user, this method will apply the update. If the update is successfully applied, the application will shut down.

If an exception is thrown during any of these steps, a message will be shown to the user. The user can click a button to view the message of the exception and any inner exceptions by clicking a "Show details" button.

member.name: M:Kjs.AppLife.Update.Controller.UpdateController.ShowCheckForUpdateDialog
member.summary: Searches for an available update while showing a modal dialog to the user.
member.returns: DialogResult.OK if an update was found and the user clicked the "Get update" button; otherwise, DialogResult.Cancel.

remarks.para: This method downloads director.xml from and scans it for an available update. This method blocks while the dialog is displayed. To check for updates and continue executing while waiting for the check to complete, use . To check for updates without showing a dialog, use .

If an update is found, the dialog will allow the user to choose to either get the update or cancel the operation. If the user chooses to get the update, this method returns DialogResult.OK, but the update is not automatically downloaded; you must call , , or to download the update.

If an exception is thrown while checking for an update, the dialog will display an error message to the user. The user can click view the message of the exception and any inner exceptions by clicking a "Show details" button.
If an error occurs, the user cancels the check, no update is found, or the dialog is closed without the user clicking the "Get update" button, this method returns DialogResult.Cancel.

If an update is found, the dialog shows the update's HistoricalSummaryText by default. If no update is found, the dialog shows by default. To change the text displayed in the dialog, add an event handler to the event.

member.summary: Occurs when applying an update requires the application to terminate.

remarks.para: This event is raised whenever the controller needs to shut down its hosting application in order to apply an update. The hosting application is shut down during a call to or . This event is raised from all instances that share the of the on which was called.

If a handler for this event sets to , the update will not be applied and will return false. If any other controller takes too long to respond, will throw an and the update will not be applied. When calling , an exception will not be thrown, but the update will not be applied and an error message will be shown to the user.
This method is raised last from the controller that will apply the update, and only if all other controllers did not time out or cancel the event.
When an update is applied using the option, this event is still raised on all instances, but no processes will be automatically shutdown. The update process can still be cancelled by this event.

member.name: E:Kjs.AppLife.Update.Controller.UpdateController.UpdateFound
member.summary: Occurs when one or more updates have been found.

remarks.para: This event is raised whenever the controller has found an update that can be applied to its . Updates are found during calls to , , , and . When multiple updates are found, the controller will select the one with the highest version. Handlers of the event can check information about all of the updates that have been found and use custom criteria to select the one to be shown to the user, downloaded, and applied.
The event may be raised on a thread-pool worker thread.

The class provides data for the event; handlers can check all applicable updates with the property and choose the update to be applied by setting . If is set to , the controller will indicate that no update is available.
